leads.name: Olive of Bemparece, Lagoa

location.address: Lagoa-Bemparece road, near the Jacinto Correia school, Lagoa

leads.reason: no photo or exact pin in reach; no life evidence after the 2006 register measurement and a 2008 blog (trunk partly hidden by shoots, set back from the road); no iNaturalist or Commons record within 300 m. ICNF KNJ1/333: girth 8.2 m, 10.6 m, register age 1000 (2006), classified 1999. Roadside, public road. Worth a reader fix.
leads.source: data/registers/portugal-icnf.json; http://arvores-do-sul.blogspot.com (A Oliveira Classificada de Lagoa, mirrored at plantas.hi7.co)

leads.name: Stone pine of Marachique (Sitio do Pinheiro), Alvor

location.address: N531-1 Portimao-Alvor, Sitio do Pinheiro, Marachique

leads.reason: no life evidence since a 2008 blog (girth 4.3 m, 9.75 m, crown 19.4 m, about 200 years, classified 1996); iNaturalist none within 150 m; stands on a private owner's land beside the road, no plaque in 2008. Needs a reader fix.

leads.name: Millennial Olive of Morgado do Quintao
leads.reason: Tree of the Year 2022 candidate (Wilder, Algarve Holiday Lets: about 2,000 years, 5 m tall, 4 m girth) but on a private wine estate reached by prior booking (tastings and lunches) with a gated entrance; no coordinate; not in ICNF register. Access by booking could count under rule 10, but no source seen on this pass says the olive is shown on a visit.

leads.name: Olive of Tor, Loule
leads.reason: Almargem survey of Loule (2006): chest girth 8.07 m, 9 m tall, crown 13 m, said to be the largest olive girth in the Algarve; a 2008 blog puts it on private land in the village centre; no coordinate, no register entry in our ICNF extract, no recent evidence. Smaller olive beside it: girth 5.34 m.

leads.name: Holm oak of Almarginho, Salir (Loule)
leads.reason: Almargem 2006 survey: girth 4.17 m, 15.5 m tall, crown 21.4 m, 'one of the largest in the Algarve'; no coordinate, no life evidence.

leads.name: Carob of Porto da Pedra, Boliqueime (Loule)
leads.reason: Almargem 2006 survey: girth 7.5 m, 7 m tall, crown 13.1 m, 'one of the largest in the Algarve'; no coordinate, no life evidence, probably farmland.

leads.reason: unclassified neighbour of tav_001: girth about 6 m, 11 m tall, crown 11.7 m (2007 blog 'A sombra verde'). Same resort access question; no own coordinate.

leads.name: Faro Jardim Manuel Bivar

leads.name: Estoi Palace gardens
leads.reason: not checked in depth; the palace is a hotel (pousada) with garden access tied to guests or paid visits; no named tree found in this pass.

blocked.name: Carob of Quinta da Parra, Moncarapacho (Olhao)
blocked.reason: private property, not open to free visits; any visit needs prior authorisation from the owner company Parra da Alfarrobeira, Sociedade Agrícola, Lda (negrilho.pt, 3 Aug 2026). Hard rule 10: permission needed. Otherwise a superb tree: ICNF KNJ1/392, girth 13.4 m (2001, at 1.30 m), 14 m, crown 15.5 m, about 600 years, alive 2026 (visited August 2026; subject of 'Uma Arvore' exhibition at Tavira museum 4 July to 24 October 2026). Revisit if the owner opens visits.

blocked.name: Olive at Escola EB 2,3 do Algoz, Silves
blocked.reason: school grounds with no evidence they are open (hard rule 10). ICNF KNJ1/341: girth 7.15 m (a blog measured 7.66 m), 1999 classification; a pupil set a fire in its trunk cavity around 2008 and it survived.

notes: Verification pass 2026-10-29 (Faro and central/eastern Algarve). Delivered data/research/faro-verified.json: tav_001 (Oliveira Real, Tavira, resort access flagged) and sba_001 (Azinheira de Alportel, Sao Bras de Alportel). The ICNF Faro district has only nine registered entries and they are all singles; no cluster of four exists, so these ship as tree pages. Hosts: overpass-api.de and overpass.kumi.systems timed out, sulinformacao.pt and publico.pt 403, Commons geosearch sometimes 'too busy' (retry).
